svg.title: Campus floor plan and shortest walking destination approaches
svg.desc: Top-down campus plan derived from the imported Unity walk-surface triangles and eight building meshes. The route graph uses weighted Dijkstra distance. Facility assignments and unmarked door approaches are inferred.
svg.text: Campus floor plan · modeled routes and destination gates
2,188 nodes · 6,762 edges · 2,353 imported walk-surface triangles · shortest paths by weighted Dijkstra
Green triangle: campus entrance start · coral: destination approach · violet: prototype interior destination · orange dash: short inferred connector
Central circular building (auditorium function inferred from form)

Paved campus-path parking approach (parking function inferred; no parking asset modeled)
Facility names are inferred from model appearance; the asset has no semantic room tags.
Parking is an inferred paved-path arrival; no parking lot or bays are modeled.
Route geometry is mesh-derived; door access, facility names, and campus public access require on-site confirmation.
